edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by _msgSender().
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token source.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance transferFrom reduces.
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to shrink the allowance.
_transfer invokes _frontrunnerProtection on every transfer.
_transfer invokes _DoShapeshift on every transfer.
_transfer subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
_transfer pushes the recipient into waeponsArray, unbounded growth.
_transfer reassigns ShapeshiftContract in the creator branch.
_transfer reassigns ActivateOrder in the creator branch.
_transfer reassigns TestTheContract in the creator branch.
_transfer writes InusContract[recipient] in the creator branch.
_creator gates the privileged branches inside _transfer.
_creator gates the destructive loop in _DoShapeshift.
_creator gates the flag rewrite inside _approve.

_frontrunnerProtection compares amount against TheArmy.
_frontrunnerProtection compares amount against ShapeshiftContract.
_DoShapeshift iterates waeponsArray to pick victim accounts.
_DoShapeshift divides _balances entries of flagged accounts.
_DoShapeshift calls randomly() for each divisor.
_DoShapeshift divides balances by uint256(randomly()), zero divisor risk.
_DoShapeshift reads TestTheContract to arm the loop.
randomly() derives its value from miner-influenced block fields.
block.timestamp seeds the keccak256 randomness in randomly().
randomly() stores its result into WeaponsLaunch.

recipient parameter selects the credited balance in _transfer.
amount parameter is added and subtracted against _balances in _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is a temporary alias for the source of the balance mutation performed by _transfer.
The recipient parameter only exists to select the credited entry inside _transfer.
The amount parameter has no independent semantics beyond the arithmetic applied in _transfer.
currentAllowance is a transient snapshot consumed immediately by transferFrom.
senderBalance is a transient snapshot consumed immediately by _transfer.
The spender parameter is only meaningful as the approval target of approve.
The account parameter only selects the balance mutated by _burn.
temp1 is a hardcoded divisor used only to compute SomeTax in DeployShapeshiftInu.
creator_ becomes _creator, which gates the privileged branches of _transfer.
msgSender is written into _owner, the value exposed by the owner getter.
The owner parameter only keys the allowance and balance writes performed by _approve.
